title: The created creators
statement: Per the canon, the Elohim were themselves created: their civilization discovered that it too was the product of designers from elsewhere, who were created in turn — an unbounded chain of creation with no first creator, coherent with the infinite cosmos of woh-claim-0023; the corpus deploys the chain as the framework's answer to the who-designed-the-designer regress objection, converting the regress from a refutation into the canon's own cosmological structure.

includes: The canonical statement: the Elohim's own discovered createdness and their creation of life in turn — the chain running in both temporal directions without a first term
The coherence link: an unbounded chain requires the unbounded cosmos woh-claim-0023 records; the two premises stand or fall together

The argumentative deployment: the regress objection to design inference (the designer must have evolved or been designed) is accepted and absorbed — each designer is natural and created; no terminal designer is posited
excludes: Any claim that the chain terminates or that a supreme being anchors it; the canon's atheism is constitutive here
Evidence for the chain beyond the canon's report; the record is canon-derived
The evolutionary origin of any given link's designers; the canon reports the chain, not its links' biology
Design-inference arguments from terrestrial biology, which are woh-claim-0036's territory

source_references.locator: The passages on the Elohim's own creators and the continuation of the chain through humanity's future creations
The second message's development of the chain and its infinity
The scientific formulation showing a created-life hypothesis is stateable without a terminal designer — formulability context, not endorsement

alternatives.statement: An infinite chain does not answer the regress; it postpones explanation forever, and abiogenesis-plus-evolution somewhere remains the only terminating account.
An unbounded past chain conflicts with standard cosmology's finite past; the chain inherits every objection to woh-claim-0023 plus a temporal one.
Creators-with-creators is a recurring theogonic pattern (divine genealogies); the canon's version modernizes the pattern rather than reporting a discovery.

revision_triggers: Claim woh-claim-0001 or woh-claim-0023 is revised or retired.
The canon's fuller context changes the chain's description.
Public prose begins positing a terminal term or claiming evidential support, both of which this record excludes.
